speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand the nature of these symptoms better. Have your hand tremors started suddenly or developed gradually, and are they present when your hands are at rest or only when you use them? Also, have you noticed any changes in your gait, balance, or speech patterns recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details; the progressive nature of the left-hand tremor alongside memory decline suggests a neurodegenerative process. Do you have any history of falls, or do you feel you are shuffling your feet more than usual when walking? Additionally, have you noticed any stiffness or slowness in your movements?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease with early cognitive decline (Dementia with Lewy Bodies).
